name: Lines from facial movement
summary: Repeated muscle movement gradually etches lines into the skin that remain visible even at rest, long after the expression that made them has passed.
statement: Repeated muscle movement gradually *etches lines into the skin* that remain visible even at rest, long after the expression that made them has passed.
happening: Expression relies on repeated movement of the same muscles, and over time that repeated movement leaves a visible line in skin at rest. Some lines only appear during movement; others remain visible afterwards. Which category a line falls into changes what is likely to help, which is why assessment happens before any recommendation.

factors.title: Gradual structural change
factors.text: Lines from facial movement typically develop gradually beneath the surface, which is why they are often noticed later than they began.

factors.title: Individual rate of change
factors.text: The pace at which lines from facial movement progress varies between patients, shaped by genetics, lifestyle and skin type.

factors.title: Compounding factors
factors.text: Lines from facial movement rarely occur in isolation, and are usually assessed alongside related structural changes nearby.

recommendedText: Considered for lines that remain visible at rest, where softening the underlying muscle movement is the most direct approach available.
alongsideText: Often assessed alongside, since these concerns frequently share the same treatment options.

steps.title: Assessment first
steps.text: We look at each line during movement and at rest, since which kind it is changes what is likely to help.

steps.title: Movement and rest
steps.text: Lines that appear only with expression and lines that remain at rest are considered differently.

steps.title: A conservative approach
steps.text: Treatment softens lines while keeping natural expression, rather than stilling the face.

steps.title: Ongoing review
steps.text: Lines respond over time, so the plan is reviewed at follow-up and adjusted as needed.
